source_note: OCSF schema notes for the prototype (OCSF-compatible, targeting 1.3.0). Not certified.

items.title: OCSF Authentication (class_uid 3002)
items.text: Authentication events. Core: time, activity_id, class_uid, type_uid, status_id, user, src_endpoint, dst_endpoint, auth_protocol. status_id 1=Success, 2=Failure.

items.title: OCSF Network Activity (class_uid 4001)
items.text: Network flows. Core: src_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.ip, dst_endpoint.port, connection_info.protocol_ver, traffic.bytes_out/bytes_in, url.url_string.

items.title: OCSF Process Activity (class_uid 1007)
items.text: Process launch/terminate. Core: process.name, process.cmd_line, process.parent_process, device.hostname, user.name.

items.title: OCSF File System Activity (class_uid 1001)
items.text: File access. Core: file.name, file.path, file.type, user.name, device.hostname. Prototype extension unmapped.is_canary marks synthetic canaries.

items.title: Prototype defence extensions (unmapped)
items.text: Non-core fields under unmapped: site_id, asset_criticality, user_role, mission_state, network_zone, clock_uncertainty_ms, sensor_confidence, classification, scenario_id.
